europe_now.title: Widespread Unrest and Protests in France
europe_now.summary: France faces severe political fallout and security challenges following a weekend of widespread violent protests and riots across multiple cities. President Emmanuel Macron addressed the nation to call for calm and order while vowing full transparency.

europe_now.title: Diplomatic Condemnation Over West Bank Attack
europe_now.summary: European nations including Poland and France have strongly condemned an attack by Israeli settlers against an international delegation that included European diplomats. Officials have called for accountability and an immediate halt to such acts.

top_stories.title: French Civil Unrest and Political Response
top_stories.summary: President Emmanuel Macron addressed the French public following days of intense riots and destruction that left numerous towns and cities reeling. Foreign leaders have also commented on the domestic crisis as security forces continue to manage ongoing clashes.

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Fallout Over West Bank Violence
top_stories.summary: European governments have issued sharp rebukes following an assault by Israeli settlers on a diplomatic delegation. The incident involved European diplomats and has triggered formal condemnations from countries like Poland and France.
